title: Plugin entry (plugins/<id>/plugin.json)
description: Catalog data of one official plugin. Changes need human review.

name.description: The plugin name, exactly as in the `name` field of its manifest.json.

repository.description: Public GitHub repository. Its name must be `bbb-plugin-<id>`.

status.description: production: official and maintained. discontinued: kept for existing users, no security fixes. archived: no longer listed as installable.

build.description: Exceptions to the default central build. Every exception is reviewed by the committee.

allowNetwork.description: Let `npm run build-bundle` reach the network.

allowInstallScripts.description: Run npm install scripts during `npm ci`.
